errors.text_span: specifically for the Embedding and Language Model (LM) Head components in the RedWhale Korean LLM, as described in the paper “RedWhale: An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining.”
errors.evidence: The description includes detailed context from the paper's title and caption, which are not visually part of the figure image itself. A description should primarily focus on what is visually represented.
The phrase 'visually emphasizes' is subjective and interpretive. A neutral description should state what the chart shows, rather than interpreting the intent or effect of the visual design.

The word 'significantly' is an evaluative term that implies statistical importance, which is an interpretation not explicitly stated in the chart. The description should state the observed difference without such qualification.
